office: Office of the City Agriculturist, Biñan City, Laguna

lines.source: Biñan City 2026 Citizen's Charter, 1st Edition: the Office of the City Agriculturist runs the Municipal Fisherfolk Registration Program (FishR, p. 203) and Fish Pen Registration (p. 204)

⚠️ Off for Biñan: no source found for a rice area or a rice barangay in Biñan (slice 7m research, 2026-11-02). The same Citizen's Charter (p. 198) lists a seed and fertilizer subsidy for "Registered Biñan Rice Farmers" on a rice farmers' master list, but gives no hectares or barangays. Turn it on with PCIC_COMMODITIES once the City Agriculture Office confirms where rice is grown.
